verdict.rationale: Operating a government online-services portal through natural-language commands, such as via a chatbot or AI assistant, is a fair axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the pack documents one: the docs describe only conventional web forms (Online Services, Web File, Quick Pay, calculators). The probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec, and the Online Services transaction paths are robots-disallowed for agents.
